text:
Sam: quick brainstorm — running a small split-test on pricing page next week. two variants: 'Pathfinder' micro-estimator vs 'ClearBands' simplified tiers. goal = better signal for intent + lift demo signups.
Nora: Pathfinder sounds fun. can we make it a 3-question micro-quiz so it's under 30s? question flow -> rough monthly cost -> CTA.
Diego: yep 3 q's max. map answers to intent buckets: exploratory, evaluating, procurement. exploratory -> webinar; evaluating -> demo; procurement -> sales outreach.
Rhea: CS wants an enterprise flag in the form (hidden) if company_domains list matches. also need an opt-out link for existing customers.
Sam: proposed copy snippets below, keep them tight.
```
ClearBands CTA: "Schedule a 15-minute demo"
ClearBands subcopy: "Transparent plans. Enterprise features available."
Pathfinder CTA after quiz: "See your estimate" -> modal -> "Join webinar" or "Request demo"
```
Nora: microcopy tweak: change "See your estimate" to "Get a quick estimate" 14 feels less salesy.
Diego: routing rules: enterprise when company_size >= 250 OR domain in allowlist. send enterprise leads to /sales/inbound with tag "pricing-pathfinder". SDRs get evaluating bucket. webinar signups go to nurture flow.
ExperimentBot: created experiment id exp-3107, feature flag=pricing_pathfinder, start=2026-04-01, rollout=10%->50%->100% over 3 days.
Sam: metrics: primary = demo click-through rate (CTRs); secondary = webinar RSVPs, time-on-page, estimator completion rate, MQL conversion. target lifts: +12% demo CTR (ClearBands), +18% estimator completion (Pathfinder), -6% bounce.
Nora: add tracking events: `estimator_started`, `estimator_completed`, `cta_click`, `form_submit`, `enterprise_flag=true`. also capture `time_on_page_seconds`.
Rhea: timeline check: copy + design by Mon, analytics + QA Tues, dev integration Wed, internal preview Thurs, soft launch Fri. can engineering take an hour slot Wed morning for routing endpoints?
Diego: pinged @growth-eng for Wed 11am. will need a short API (`/api/route-lead`) that accepts bucket and flags.
Sam: bench narrative for comms: "In prior experiments, simplifying choices increased action rates; this test pits clarity-first vs personalization-first." marketing needs a 1-line for external promo: "Find the right plan for your team in under 30 seconds."
Nora: for webinar copy: "Live walkthrough: how teams reduce inference cost without latency tradeoffs. 30 min." keep CTA separate from demo flow.
Rhea: CS will create canned responses and a short playbook for routing webinar vs demo leads. I'll include sample subject lines for outreach.
Diego: also add a small trust badge under ClearBands CTA: "SLA options • SOC2 & ISO". keeps enterprise trust without long copy.
ExperimentBot: exp-3107 updated: tags=[pricing, micro-estimator, webinar-routing], dashboard link=https://metrics.redwood/exp-3107
Sam: great. any blockers?
Nora: none from design.
Rhea: I'll confirm the allowlist domains and drop them into the experiment config.
Diego: dev ready for Wed slot.
Sam: I'll drop the experiment doc in marketing drive and loop in product for QA. launching when flags are green. :sparkles:
